description: This file defines the Zend_XmlRpc_Fault class, which manages XML-RPC fault responses, including fault codes, messages, XML serialization, and fault detection.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Fault
classes.description: Class for representing and handling XML-RPC fault responses, including loading from XML, serialization, and fault detection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a fault with a code and message, defaulting to 404 and internal message if not provided.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Sets the encoding for the fault response and updates the related class.

methods.name: loadXml
methods.description: Loads a fault from an XML string, parsing fault code and message, and handling errors.

methods.name: isFault
methods.description: Static method to determine if a given XML string represents an XML-RPC fault.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Serializes the fault object into an XML string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the XML representation of the fault.
